correctness.rationale: The incircle and circumcircle regimes are exact. In the intermediate range, two excluded generating-disk lunes cannot overlap in area: if \(x\) were outside two radius-\(w\) disks, the sum of the two squared distances would exceed \(2w^2\), while the equilateral-vector identity gives at most \(2r^2+2d^2+2rd<6d^2=2w^2\) for \(r<d\). Standard two-circle segment geometry gives \(L(r)\), and polar coarea gives \(A'(r)=2r(\pi-3\alpha)\); endpoint angles are \(0\) and \(\pi/3\). Independent polar quadrature at three interior radii matched the closed form to about \(10^{-10}\).
